description: The Bade’e Al Oud His & Hers Bundle pairs two bold interpretations of modern oud — one refined and smooth, the other rich and indulgent — creating a perfectly balanced couples fragrance experience. Sublime delivers elegant oud blended with refined sweetness and smooth woods, offering a polished, confident masculine presence. Honor & Glory adds a luxurious gourmand-amber twist to oud, with warmth, richness, and an addictive glow that feels bold yet elegant. Together, these fragrances form a harmonized oud duo — powerful, memorable, and perfectly suited for couples who appreciate luxury Middle Eastern perfumery. Ideal for gifting, anniversaries, holidays, or couples who want complementary yet distinct signature scents.
